name: Mathify
description: Mathify turns natural language prompts into animated math and physics visualizations. Describe a concept—like derivatives, vectors, integrals, or geometric transformations—and Mathify generates a ready-to-render animation. It’s built for students, educators, and technical creators who want to explain ideas clearly without manually writing animation code.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mathify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mathify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mathify.dev/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mathify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mathify provides these MCP tools: get_mathify_animation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mathify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mathify in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Mathify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mathify is developed by TecunTecs, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
